title: Foam mat drying of perishable products: a critical review of process parameters, product quality, and sustainable prospects
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00203F, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Swanand Kalambe, Sadanand Guhe
Foam mat drying is an energy-efficient method for preserving heat-sensitive foods and bioactive compounds. This review highlights foaming agents, process parameters, applications, sustainability aspects, and alignment with SDG 12 for industrial use.
